chr_0040_sweetpie.name: Kay
chr_0040_sweetpie.quote: Hiya! I'm Cerube, but my friends call me Kay. My big, huge, enormous dream is to explore every corner of Talos-II a bazillion times! You can come along too, as long as you bring your own snacks.
chr_0040_sweetpie.profile:
"All the way from there to here... Whoa, I've come so far and taken down so many bad guys!"

Young in age and hearty in appetite, Kay left Rhodes Island to embark on her journey, determined to explore every inch of Talos-II, driven by one simple wish: to find Endfield and the Endministrator. Before she knew it, her footprints could be found in every corner of this planet, and she had made friends along every memorable stretch of her journey.

Even now, skilled as she is with her backpack stuffed full, Kay remains curious about the world around her, and the stories of Endfield and the
Endministrator have inspired a new dream in her. As for how to make that dream come true, Kay has had an idea for some time—

"Chill this, sizzle that. All you need is a little boom, bam, pow! Annnd done! I've always kept things super easy peasy."

skills.name: Wild Wacky-Whack
skills.description:
**BASIC ATTACK:**
An attack with up to 5 sequences that deals ⟦phys|Physical DMG⟧. As the controlled operator, ⟦key|Final Strike⟧ also deals ⟦stagger|17⟧ Stagger.
**DIVE ATTACK:**
Basic attack performed in mid-air becomes a dive attack that deals ⟦phys|Physical DMG⟧ to nearby enemies.
**FINISHER:**
Basic attack performed near a Staggered enemy becomes a finisher attack that deals massive ⟦phys|Physical DMG⟧ and recovers some SP.

skills.name: "Really Heavy Bash"
skills.description:
**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Kay leaps into mid-air for a short power-up, salvages all her ⟦key|Weapons⟧, then unleashes a powerful ground bash with her heavy hammer. The bash deals Nature DMG (based on her ⟦key|Hot Edgy Naives⟧ stacks), applies ⟦key|Nature Infliction⟧ on enemies within the area of effect, and consumes all ⟦key|Hot Edgy Naives⟧ stacks. If Kay consumes 3 ⟦key|Hot Edgy Naives⟧ stacks, she also forcibly applies ⟦key|Combustion⟧ on enemies.
⟦muted|If ＞ 3 Hot Edgy Naives stacks are consumed, the effects will be the same as those for 3 stacks.⟧

values.label: Bonus DMG Multiplier per Hot Edgy Naives

skills.name: "Really Kwik Smash"
skills.description:
**COMBO TRIGGER:** While Kay has ≥ 1 ⟦key|Weapon⟧ and either ⟦key|Nature Infliction⟧ is applied OR ⟦key|Arts Burst⟧ DMG is dealt to the enemy.
**SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Kay throws a ⟦key|Weapon⟧ at the target to deal Nature DMG. Hitting the enemy recovers some SP and also forcibly applies a ⟦key|Nature Burst⟧. The ⟦key|Weapon⟧ will then drop at a random location in the battlefield. Kay ⟦key|salvages⟧ the said ⟦key|Weapon⟧ when the controlled operator touches it.

skills.name: "Really Sweet Combi-Bonker!"
skills.description: **SKILL DESCRIPTION:** Kay kitbashes a combi-bonker that she swings multiple times before throwing it to cause an explosion that deals Nature DMG and applies ⟦key|Nature Infliction⟧ on enemies within the area of effect, recovers some SP, and leaves behind multiple ⟦key|Picnic Snacks⟧. When the controlled operator touches a ⟦key|Picnic Snack⟧ and picks it up, Kay grants HP treatment to the said operator and recovers some SP. The attribute of Agility increases the amount of HP treatment.
